relations.relationship: Uses Elizabeth Marsh’s itinerant life to investigate transcontinental connections and women’s place in global history.
relations.evidence_note: Author’s answers on biography, missing letters and reconstructing Marsh through others’ writings. This identifies a specific biographical project, without treating one life as representative of every woman or attributing the book’s sources to Colley.
